title: How to highlight textures in packshots?
h1: How do you highlight textures through a photo?
metaTitle: Product texture capture: Pro method with Alphashot G2 💄
description: Discover how to enhance the texture of your products in photography thanks to the Orbitvu photo studio. Offer a faithful and detailed rendering to your customers to capture attention and encourage them to buy!
tool: Orbitvu Station software and a blush
introText:
In product photography, every detail counts. For brands of cosmetic And of modus, textures and materials play an essential role in transmitting the quality and authenticity of the product. 👟👗💄

Thanks to modern tools like Orbitvu Alphashot Pro G2, it is now possible to capture these nuances accurately and optimize production flows. 📊

Follow this guide for professional visuals that highlight the textures of your products.

steps.title: Place and center the product
steps.content:
The first step in taking a successful shot is positioning. With the Alphashot Pro G2, this task becomes easy thanks to its built-in laser pointer which shows you the center of the turntable. 📍

Ensure that the surface of the product is clean and free of dust or visible defects, as these details will clearly appear in the image. 🔍

Precise centering guarantees consistency in your shots, especially important for product series or comparative visuals.
steps.structuredText: The first step to a successful shot is product positioning. Thanks to the Alphashot Pro G2's built-in laser pointer, it's easy to locate the exact center of the turntable and place the object precisely there. Before starting the capture, make sure that the surface of the product is clean, free of dust or visible defects, as every detail will be perfectly reproduced in the image. Precise centering ensures essential visual consistency, especially for product series or visuals intended for comparison.

steps.title: Choice of the light template generated by the AI assistant
steps.content:
Textures require special attention to lighting. This is where Studio G2's AI Photo Assistant comes in. Click on the“AI” icon and let the assistant analyze your product to suggest several suitable lighting configurations. 🤖

Choose a setting that highlights the details: a low lighting (almost parallel to the studio set) is ideal for bringing out reliefs and textures. 💡

Adjust manually as needed for even more personalized results.
steps.structuredText: Products with textures require special attention when it comes to lighting. The Alphashot Pro G2 Studio AI Photo Assistant automates this process. Click on the “AI” icon to start the product analysis. The assistant will offer you several suitable lighting configurations. Select a setting that highlights surface details. Low lighting, oriented almost parallel to the stage, is particularly effective in revealing reliefs and textures. If necessary, manually adjust the settings to fine-tune the rendering according to your preferences.

steps.title: Camera settings
steps.content:
To capture textures accurately, a few specific camera settings are essential: 📷

  • Opt for a low aperture (f/8 or higher) for sufficient depth of field, ensuring that all of the texture will be in focus.
  • Use a low ISO sensitivity to avoid grain, which is particularly annoying when it comes to fine details.

With Orbitvu photo studios, these settings can be saved in templates, which greatly simplifies your next photo shoots. 🔄
steps.structuredText: To accurately capture the textures of a product, some specific camera settings are required: Aperture: Choose a small aperture (f/8 or more) to obtain sufficient depth of field, ensuring consistent texture sharpness. ISO: Use low ISO to avoid digital noise, which is especially annoying when capturing fine details. With Orbitvu photo studios, these settings can be saved in templates, which facilitates future photo sessions by ensuring visual consistency.

steps.title: Focus stacking - the first step
steps.content:
For some products, the technique of Focus Stacking is essential for completely clear photos. 🔍

Activate it Superfocus and choose The Assistant to help you with focus stacking. To get started, double-click on the front of your product (the part closest to the camera). This will make it possible to fix the point of the first focus. 📌

Click “next” and double click on the back of your product (the part farthest from the camera).
steps.structuredText: For some products, especially those with significant depth, the focus stacking technique is essential in order to obtain a completely clear image. Activate the Superfocus function in the software, then select the Wizard to be guided step-by-step through the procedure. To set the first focus, double-click on the front of the product (the area closest to the camera). Then click “Next” and double-click on the back of the product (the farthest area) to finalize the sharpness range.

steps.title: Focus stacking - part 2
steps.content:
This step allows you to choose whether you want the steps between the focuses to be more or less precise. As a rule, the size of the step”by default” is sufficient and optimal.

Click “next.”
steps.structuredText: This step allows you to define the precision of the intervals between each focus in the focus stacking process. By default, the proposed step size is generally sufficient and offers an optimal result. If you don't want to change it, simply click “Next” to continue.

steps.title: Focus stacking - part three
steps.content:
Press the + button little by little until the game is clear. Be careful not to go too far, otherwise the image will become blurry again. 🔍

Click “next.”
steps.structuredText: Gradually click on the “+” button until the selected area becomes perfectly clear. Be careful not to go beyond the sharpness point, as this may cause the image to blur again. Once sharpness is achieved, click “Next” to go to the next step.

steps.title: Focus stacking - final part
steps.content: You can now move on to shooting or refine the Superfocus if necessary by clicking on “Advanced” . 🎨
steps.structuredText: You can now move on to shooting or refine Superfocus if needed by clicking on “Advanced”.

steps.title: Shooting and close-ups
steps.content:
Once the product is ready and the settings are done, it's time to start shooting. 🎬

Get an overview of the product to show the overall context of the product. Also, take close-ups to enhance specific details (such as the satin surface of a highlighter or the reliefs of a packaging).

For an immersive effect, also create 360° animations in order to show the entire product from different angles.

‍
steps.structuredText: Once the product is positioned and the settings are finalized, you can move on to the shooting phase. Start by capturing an overview of the product in order to present it in its overall context. Then take close-ups to highlight specific details, such as the satin finish of a cosmetic product or the reliefs of a package. For an immersive visual experience, also create 360° animations that allow you to visualize the product from all angles.

steps.title: Photo editing with the AutoPolisher
steps.content:
Now move on to post-production. Fortunately, the tool AutoPolisher integrated into the Obrivtu Station software and many other editing options simplify this process:

  • Automatically remove backgrounds with theIQ Mask to obtain a professional finish, ideal for use in e-commerce.
  • Optimize colors and adjust contrast to further highlight captured textures. 🎨
steps.structuredText: Move on to the post-production phase to finalize your visuals. The Orbitvu Station software integrates several tools that facilitate this process, including: AutoPolisher: to automatically correct small imperfections. IQ Mask: to remove backgrounds and get a clean look, ideal for e-commerce visuals. Retouch tools: Adjust colors, saturation, or contrast to enhance captured textures.

steps.title: Format choice and export
steps.content:
Once the edits are complete, it's time to export your files. Prepare your images in various formats adapted to your distribution channels such as the web, social networks or printed brochures.

You can also export your visuals directly to marketplaces like Shopify or Magento or on your social networks from the Orbitvu Station software. 📤

‍Also discover how to focus stacking to get clear images of your jewelry.
steps.structuredText: Once the edits are finalized, proceed to export your visuals. Prepare the files in formats adapted to your various distribution channels: web, social networks, printed brochures, etc. The Orbitvu Station software also allows direct export to platforms such as Shopify, Magento or even social networks, thus facilitating the uploading and distribution of your visual content.

faqs.question: How can this shooting system improve the profitability of my business?
faqs.answer: By automating time-consuming tasks like focus stacking and clipping, you significantly reduce production time. This increases the number of products photographed per day and improves the quality of visuals, which can boost sales.

faqs.question: Can the images taken be used in high-resolution printing?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can export in high-resolution TIFF or PNG for printed catalogs, while keeping lighter formats (JPEG, WebP) for online sales or social networks.

faqs.question: How does this workflow improve the productivity of an e-commerce team?
faqs.answer: Thanks to automation (AI Assistant, AutoPolisher, settings templates), each team member can quickly repeat the same procedure without the need for in-depth photography knowledge, allowing more visuals to be produced in less time.

faqs.question: What is the average learning curve to master the tool?
faqs.answer: Most users are up and running in a few hours thanks to the simplicity of the software, and automating key steps makes it possible to gain efficiency quickly.

faqs.question: Can the lighting be automatically adjusted according to the type of texture (metallic, matt, etc.)?
faqs.answer: Yes, thanks to the AI Photo Assistant, the software recognizes the characteristics of the surface and adjusts the 74 light sources. However, it is still possible to manually fine-tune the setting for an even more accurate result.
